shape.text: The key secret is 4b1d followed by exactly 38 mixed-case letters and digits, 42 characters in all, with no separator or checksum. A ClickHouse employee wrote in a scanner-rule contribution merged on 2025-04-16 that the prefix was chosen deliberately and gave the rule 4b1d plus 38 alphanumerics; provider-owned Terraform examples since 2023-05 and a 2024 unit-test value agree at 42 characters.
An older example key is 39 characters rather than 42.

unresolved.reason: A single knowledge-base example from 2023 is 39 characters in all; it predates the staff statement and is not recorded as a source of this family.

shape.text: The key ID (the Basic-auth username) has no marker and is 17 or 20 alphanumeric characters.

unresolved.reason: The key ID appears only as an unmarked companion of the secret and as a public identifier; no source settles its length.

issuance.text: The secret is read from CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_API_SECRET, with its key ID in CLICKHOUSE_CLOUD_API_KEY, or set as the Terraform token_secret; the pair is used as HTTP Basic credentials with the key ID as user name.
The API accepts a caller-supplied pre-hashed secret, so a secret created that way has no fixed shape.
An admin key can create, scale and delete services and manage members.

collisions.text: 4b1d is valid hexadecimal, so a hash digest that starts with it, or a UUID containing -4b1d-, can contain the marker without being a key.
